$comment: Drop-in theme manifest for Vibe Kanban (local web). Add a new entry + a matching <id>.css file in this folder to register a custom theme; no rebuild required. Each CSS file scopes its token overrides to html[data-theme-variant="<id>"].

themes.name: Navy HUD
themes.description: Cyan-on-navy sci-fi HUD with CRT scanlines and glow.

themes.name: Phosphor
themes.description: Classic green-CRT terminal, heavy scanlines, monochrome mono.

themes.name: Amber Terminal
themes.description: Amber command-line aesthetic on deep navy, CRT texture.

themes.name: Noir Neon
themes.description: Near-black charcoal base with electric neon-orange accent and soft glow.

themes.name: Violet Synth
themes.description: Synthwave console: magenta glow on deep violet, cyan status accents.

themes.name: Ghost White
themes.description: P4 white-phosphor monochrome VDU on cold blue-black.

themes.name: Redline
themes.description: Alert-red console on scorched near-black, amber warnings.

themes.name: Paper TTY
themes.description: Light hardcopy teletype: warm paper stock, ribbon-red ink.
